objectives.description: Extract Index, Convert, Validate, Ingest bottom-up
Repoint four inbound cross-references (Sub-Index Management x2, Error Handling x2)
Repoint inter-file handler couplings (handle_convert/handle_ingest in Rebuild Job4, Import Pipeline, Standards Reference)

Record before/after bytes and total delta

approaches_tried.approach: Generic heading-promotion script applied '## -> #' etc to every line matching the pattern, without fence-state tracking
approaches_tried.reason: Wrongly promoted three fence-interior fake headings that are literal sample-output text (not real document structure) inside the Convert, Validate, and Index extracted spans: '## Conversion Complete' -> wrongly became '# Conversion Complete'; '## Literature Validation Report' and 11 nested headings inside its template block -> wrongly promoted one extra level; '## Index Entry Added' -> wrongly became '# Index Entry Added'. Caught by re-running the round-trip diff and noticing non-heading-promotion-pattern line-count deltas. Fixed by making promote_headings() fence-aware (track ``` state, only promote outside fences) and regenerating all three destination files from the pre-extraction original, then verified clean round-trip diffs (promotion-only, zero fence-interior corruption) before re-registering index entries.

deviations.description: Heading promotion during extraction must only touch real document-structure headings
deviations.reason: First-pass extraction script promoted fence-interior sample-output text that merely looked like a heading, in the Convert/Validate/Index sections (the exact fence-interior-heading hazard this task's own plan repeatedly warns about, just encountered on content-fidelity rather than boundary-detection). Caught via round-trip diff review before registering index entries or committing; fixed and all three destination files regenerated clean.
